about: Current Chinese internet slang for the 微博·抖音 posts (kind wb). Reviewed in a chat with the learner, refreshed about every 2 weeks (CLAUDE.md: Refreshing the slang list). The nightly run only targets terms from this list and never searches the web. Glosses are our own words.

terms.gl: tacked on at the end of a sentence as a dramatic sigh (我下班了，厉娜); from a line in the reunion show 后会友期
'no heartburn' = honest, worth it, no regrets; from an AI short-drama line 贵是贵了点，但下午干活不烧心
'so clear-headed', said half-ironically after something silly; from a viral exercise video
top tier, awesome (夯 = the top rank in a tier list)
'noise-cancel your brain': tune out the mental clutter
I'm out of ideas, I give up (helpless, joking)
crush, totally outclass (also used for looks: 颜值碾压)
the feel of a real, unpolished person (not a performance or a corporate voice)
'love you, old self': treating and comforting yourself
an unorthodox but effective shortcut (邪修做饭 = weird but working cooking hacks); from fantasy novels
'owner-curator' of a small trendy shop or brand; often teasing
'emotional value': making someone feel good (他很会提供情绪价值)
so what, what can you do — a shrug
raise a glass to yourself (for getting through something)
take it seriously, handle it properly
cheap group-buy takeaway; 拼好X = a pieced-together budget version of X
stumbled into somewhere far above your level (a fancy shop, a pro event)
'a person of refinement', said ironically about yourself
the worn-out 'office worker' look and vibe
a makeshift troupe: nobody really knows what they're doing (said of companies, the world)
acting furtive, trying not to be noticed
'pre-made person': acting on autopilot, like reheated pre-made food
a buddy for one activity only (饭搭子 = lunch buddy, 旅游搭子)
'money, come!' — a cheerful lucky phrase, often repeated
a café out in a village (a trendy weekend trip)
